summary: Cadeler A/S, a Danish offshore wind services firm, filed a 6-K with an investor presentation (Exhibit 99.1) delivered August 11, 2026, regarding its acquisition of Menck. The filing confirms the transaction but does not disclose financial terms, price per share, premium, or advisors. As an acquirer, Cadeler is expanding its capabilities. The 6-K serves as the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report, notifying investors of the acquisition. Watch for subsequent filings with valuation details, regulatory approvals, or closing conditions, which will be key for assessing the strategic fit and integration impact on Cadeler's operations.
